PRICING

Free to compare.
10% only if you order.

Our fee is waived for our first 10 projects. After that, you pay 10% of the delivered cost, and only when an order goes ahead. Everything else is passed through at cost and itemised.

WHAT YOU PAY FOR

Fabrication Intelligence services, prices and key features
ServicePriceKey features
Sourcing comparisonFreeNo obligation to order.
  • Reply within 48 hours
  • Up to three options within 7 days
  • Full delivered cost in AUD for each option
  • Inclusions, exclusions and assumptions shown
Order management10% of the delivered costOnly if you order. Waived for our first 10 projects.
  • Supplier checks: WERS energy rating, AGWA membership, business licence and test reports
  • Third-party inspection before shipping
  • Freight, customs broker and final delivery coordinated
  • One point of contact until delivery
Product and delivery costsAt cost, itemisedQuoted in AUD before you commit.
  • Factory price, freight, insurance, duty, GST, inspection and final delivery, each on its own line
InstallationNot includedWe start supply-only.
  • We can point you to local installers

EXAMPLE

A$15,000 of windows,
a A$1,500 fee.

If a whole-house window package has a delivered cost of A$15,000, our fee is A$1,500. If you decide not to order, you pay nothing.
